description: 11ème PROGRAMME : CAPTAGES PRIORITAIRES is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by artois-picardie.eaufrance.fr. Different zonings have been defined to guide the implementation of the Agency’s intervention policies over the period 2019-2024. Depending on the case, they correspond to: eligibility criteria, i.e. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "11th PROGRAMME: PRIORITY CAPTAGES" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
